lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath pu(n)n poojaa naam saachaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, charity and worship, are found in the love of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap saaje thaap vekhai tisai bhaanaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself creates, establishes and beholds all, by the Pleasure of His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਲੜੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saajan raa(n)g ra(n)geelaRe ra(n)g laal banaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: My friends are happy in the Love of the Lord; they nurture love for their Beloved. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਆਗੂ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa aagoo je theeai kiu paadhar jaanai ||
lines.translation: If a blind man is made the leader, how will he know the way?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap musai mat hochheeai kiu raahu pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: He is impaired, and his understanding is inadequate; how will he know the way?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu raahi jaavai mahal paavai a(n)dh kee mat a(n)dhalee ||
lines.translation: How can he follow the path and reach the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? Blind is the understanding of the blind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੂਡੌ ਧੰਧਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naam har ke kachh na soojhai a(n)dh boodau dha(n)dhalee ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, they cannot see anything; the blind are drowned in worldly entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਚਾਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: din raat chaanan chaau upajai sabad gur kaa man vasai ||
lines.translation: Day and night, the Divine Light shines forth and joy wells up, when the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kar joR gur pahi kar bina(n)tee raahu paadhar gur dasai ||6||
lines.translation: With your palms pressed together, pray to the Guru to show you the way. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaiaa ||
lines.translation: If the man becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਖੋਲੑਉ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis pahi kholh ga(n)thaRee dookhee bhar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Unto whom should I tie up and give the bundle of my pains?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookhee bhar aaiaa jagat sabaaiaa kaun jaanai bidh mereeaa ||
lines.translation: The whole world is overflowing with pain and suffering; who can know the state of my inner self?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੇ ਜਾਵਣੇ ਖਰੇ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavane jaavane khare daraavane tot na aavai phereeaa ||
lines.translation: Comings and goings are terrible and dreadful; there is no end to the rounds of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਊਣੇ ਝੂਣੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam vihoone oone jhoone naa gur sabad sunaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, he is vacant and sad; he does not listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: If the mind becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharapur leenaa ||
lines.translation: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sevaa taa(n) kare sach sabad pateenaa ||
lines.translation: The sevadar performs selfless service when he is pleased, and confirmed in the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅੰਕੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade pateejai a(n)k bheejai s mahal mahalaa a(n)tare ||
lines.translation: Confirmed in the Shabad, with her being softened by devotion, the bride dwells in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, deep within her being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karataa kare soee prabh aap a(n)t nira(n)tare ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself creates; God Himself, in the end, is endless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਾਜੰਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabad melaa taa(n) suhelaa baaja(n)t anahad beenaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is united, and then embellished; the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharipur leenaa ||8||
lines.translation: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kar vekhai soee ||
lines.translation: Why praise that which is created? Praise instead the One who created it and watches over it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai koee ||
lines.translation: His value cannot be estimated, no matter how much one may wish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: keemat so paavai aap jaanaavai aap abhul na bhulae ||
lines.translation: He alone can estimate the Lord's value, whom the Lord Himself causes to know. He is not mistaken; He does not make mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਮੁਲਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar karahi tudh bhaavahi gur kai sabad amulae ||
lines.translation: He alone celebrates victory, who is pleasing to You, through the Invaluable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਣਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: heenau neech karau bena(n)tee saach na chhodau bhaaee ||
lines.translation: I am lowly and abject - I offer my prayer; may I never forsake the True Name, O Sibling of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੯॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin kar dekhiaa devai mat saaee ||9||2||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation, watches over it; He alone bestows understanding. ||9||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa 3 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Third Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har phal paavahu ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, obtain the Lord's fruitful rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh phal paavahu har naam dhiaavahu janam janam ke dookh nivaare ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, obtain the fruit of the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name; the pains of countless lifetimes shall be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur apane vitahu jin kaaraj sabh savaare ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has arranged and resolved all my affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh kripaa kare har jaapahu sukh phal har jan paavahu ||
lines.translation: The Lord God will bestow His Grace, if you meditate on the Lord; O humble servant of the Lord, you shall obtain the fruit of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu jan bhaaee sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen O humble Sibling of Destiny: meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun har gun bheene sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat sahaje naam dhiaae ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I meditate intuitively on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau dhur likhiaa tin gur miliaa tin janam maran bhau bhaagaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meet the Guru, and their fears of birth and death leave them.
